This is a builder role that will begin as a high-impact individual contributor. The successful candidate will establish the EMEA Deal Strategy motion hands-on with the potential over time to build and lead a broader regional team.

In this role, you will serve as the EMEA Deal Strategy leader and an embedded strategic partner to account teams, with a particular focus on high-value, complex, and first-of-kind deals. You will work directly with sellers and cross-functional partners to personally lead the overall deal strategy, structuring, value narrative, negotiations, and business cases that bring business terms to contractual closure.

You will also translate insights and patterns from individual deals into a regional operating model, practical frameworks, tools, and resources that improve the quality, consistency, and scalability of deal execution across the field.

This role partners closely with Sales, Pricing, Deal Desk, Strategy, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, and Legal to help OpenAI move quickly, strengthen proposal quality, and navigate complex commercial opportunities effectively.

  • Turn lessons from strategic and bespoke deals into reusable resources that improve speed, consistency, and seller productivity.

  • Identify recurring themes across strategic deals and share insights that can inform future commercial approaches, field motions, products, and policies.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, AI, Data, People and partners together to create limitless<br>opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.wppmedia.com</p> <p>The UK is the largest market within the WPP Media EMEA region, with over 4,500 people employed<br>within the WPP Media ecosystem. We are revolutionizing our business to unlock limitless growth opportunities for our clients&nbsp;and ourselves, built on four core priorities:<br>1. Collaboration: Foster unprecedented levels of data collaboration across WPP and&nbsp;partners through WPP Open, turning every channel into a smarter opportunity.<br>2. If<br>you are passionate about an AI-driven future, thrive in a collaborative and data-centric environment, and are driven to deliver unparalleled growth, we invite you to be part of our transformative journey.</p> <p>WPP Media is a single client centric company with a portfolio of go to market brands. Wavemaker, EssenceMediacom, Mindshare and T&amp;P are our agency teams, these house multiple local and global clients. In addition, we have several dedicated client brands, such as OpenDoor (Amazon), MFG (Google), OpenMind (Nestle), OpenConnect (BT/EE) and Media Futures Group (Google). All of these teams are supported by consistent capabilities, enterprise level tools and systems and our market leading OPEN platform.</p> <p><strong>About WPP Media Group Operations</strong><br>WPP Media Group Operations is a central function within WPP, dedicated to driving operational&nbsp;excellence and efficiency across the business. We foster a collaborative and dynamic environment where individuals can thrive and&nbsp;contribute to the success of the organization.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Associate Director is a senior delivery and operational consultancy role within the Intelligence pillar of Strategic Operations. Working closely with the Director, Intelligence, the role will take ownership of defined client and UK-wide workstreams across taxonomy, CCUID adoption, Campaign Governance, data quality and reporting enablement.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role sits between the Manager and the Director roles. It requires greater independence, judgement and stakeholder leadership than the Manager role, while remaining focused on translating the Intelligence strategy into practical delivery rather than owning the overall strategy or technical capability roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Associate Director will lead discovery, shape recommendations, coordinate implementation and drive adoption across Planning, Activation, Analytics, Finance, Data &amp; Technology and product teams. They will create structure within ambiguous environments, proactively manage delivery risks and bring clear options and recommendations to the Director, Intelligence.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Attributes&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Highly organised and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of multiple workstreams and maintain momentum without constant direction.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to communicate complex subjects clearly and concisely.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the ability to build trust and bring together teams with different priorities.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Curious and comfortable asking detailed questions to understand how campaigns, systems, data and reporting processes work in practice.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Able to create structure from ambiguity, identify root causes and turn complex challenges into practical recommendations.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Comfortable escalating risks and decisions with clear context, options and a recommended course of action.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Candidate Requirements</strong></p> <p>Essential Experience&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Experience owning and delivering cross-functional projects or workstreams within media, marketing, operations, transformation, data governance, business intelligence or technology environments.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Demonstrable experience leading discovery workshops, gathering requirements and mapping end-to-end processes.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Experience translating business needs into delivery plans, process improvements, governance approaches or technical requirements.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;A practical understanding of change adoption, including stakeholder engagement, feedback, training and ongoing improvement.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Proven ability to independently manage milestones, actions, risks, dependencies and delivery decisions.&nbsp;</p> <p>Desirable Experience&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Experience working with Analytics, Data &amp; Technology, engineering or product teams to shape and test solutions.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Familiarity with WPP Open, Campaign Governance, Campaign Performance, Power BI or comparable workflow and reporting platforms.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;An understanding of how consistent campaign data supports reliable reporting, measurement and operational efficiency.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Experience coaching junior colleagues or coordinating contributors supporting a wider workstream.&nbsp;</p> <p>Measures of Success&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Assigned workstreams progress with clear plans, ownership and stakeholder alignment, requiring limited day-to-day intervention from the VP, Intelligence.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Discovery findings are converted into clear requirements, practical recommendations and implementable next steps.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.

What you’ll do

As a Sales Manager, SME & Growth, you will be a hands‑on coach leading a pod of Account Executives focused on SMB and mid‑market customers across UK and selected EMEA territories.

You will own a team quota and run a disciplined sales operating rhythm in a high‑velocity environment.

You will embed modern sales methodologies (MEDDPICC / SPICED / Challenger), build strong outbound motions with SDRs and Marketing, and partner closely with cross‑functional teams to shape our go‑to‑market and hit ambitious growth targets.

This role is based in Manchester, United Kingdom, in a hybrid model with time split between the office and remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach and manage a high‑performing team of Account Executives serving SMB / mid‑market customers, setting clear expectations on activity, pipeline quality and performance.

  • Run a high‑quality sales operating rhythm, including weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, regular deal strategy sessions, call coaching and quarterly business reviews.

  • Embed MEDDPICC / SPICED / Challenger as the standard way of running opportunities, driving rigorous qualification, multi‑threading and consistent persona‑based messaging across the team.

  • Build and scale outbound sales motions in partnership with SDRs and Marketing, including target segment definition, outreach cadences, content, and reporting, while maintaining strong cross‑functional reporting cadences.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM hygiene, data quality and forecasting discipline, using data to manage pipeline coverage, conversion, win rates and cycle times.

  • Attract, hire and onboard A‑player AEs in partnership with Talent Acquisition, providing clear expectations, coaching and development paths for each team member.

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Revenue Strategy & Operations and other stakeholders to feed structured market feedback, shape local GTM strategy and support new market or business‑line launches.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years as a closing Account Executive selling into SMB / mid‑market segments.

  • 2+ years in a front‑line sales leadership or team‑lead role, managing AEs, carrying a team quota and operating in a high‑velocity sales environment.

  • Proven success in an individual contributor AE role, with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota in B2B sales.

  • Experience in high‑growth tech or fintech, ideally with one or more of: payments, FX, cards, accounts, or spend management products.

  • Demonstrated experience launching or scaling a new market, region or business line, rather than only inheriting an established book of business.

  • Hands‑on experience building outbound sales motions with SDRs and Marketing, including designing cadences, qualification workflows and reporting.

  • Strong, practical command of at least one modern B2B sales methodology such as MEDDPICC/MEDDIC, SPICED or Challenger, and the ability to coach others to use it effectively.

  • Ability to establish and run strong intra‑functional reporting cadences, using data and CRM insights to manage performance and communicate risk and opportunity.

  • Proven ability to coach, develop and performance‑manage Account Executives, including giving clear feedback and handling under‑performance when needed.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling multi‑product fintech or payments platforms (for example, combinations of accounts, payments, FX, cards and spend management) to CFO, finance and operations personas.

  • Direct experience implementing or scaling MEDDPICC, SPICED or Challenger methodologies across a sales team or organisation, including building templates, training and inspection frameworks.

  • Background in building or scaling sales teams in new or emerging EMEA markets

  • Familiarity with AI‑powered sales tools and modern sales tech stacks (for example, Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong/Chorus) and using them to drive productivity and insight.

  • Experience collaborating closely with Revenue Strategy & Operations and Enablement to design territories, KPIs and enablement programs that support high‑velocity sales growth.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
description: About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn. We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes. You'll help answer questions such as: Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value? Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation? What drives repeat usage, retention and churn? Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance? How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments? If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you. What you'll do Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation . Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding. Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist. Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics. Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value. Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities. Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes. Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted. Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement. You'll be great for this role if… You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis. You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value. You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation. You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them. You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use. You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence. You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making. You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style. This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK. This is a hunter role at its core - built for someone who thrives on originating and closing six- and seven-figure ARR deals in competitive, technically sophisticated markets.

You'll operate at the intersection of CPaaS, CCaaS, and the rapidly evolving CX ecosystem, working closely with channel partners, marketing, and sales development to build and convert pipeline. You'll engage C-level and senior technical buyers, guiding them through cloud migration decisions and helping them understand why Bandwidth's carrier-grade platform is the right foundation for their communications strategy.

This role is ideal for someone with 10 years of enterprise sales experience and a deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market - including key platform players, partner ecosystems, and the buying dynamics within large enterprise organisations.

What You'll Do:

New Logo Acquisition & Pipeline Generation

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through commercial and contractual close, with a focus exclusively on new logo revenue
  • Consistently self-source pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, partner-led account mapping, inbound qualification, and collaboration with the Sales Development team
  • Build and maintain a robust, accurate pipeline with high data integrity; proactively manage forecasting and opportunity hygiene
  • Execute territory plans that target high-potential enterprise accounts, identifying the right entry points and accelerating deal velocity

Channel Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and leverage relationships with channel partners to co-source, co-sell, and accelerate new logo opportunities
  • Map accounts collaboratively with partner organisations to identify mutual pipeline and avoid duplication

Executive Engagement & Deal Leadership

  • Navigate complex enterprise organisations, building relationships across C-suite, IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX leadership
  • Act as a strategic advisor, helping enterprise buyers understand cloud migration options, communication infrastructure decisions, and the long-term value of Bandwidth's platform
  • Lead complex contract negotiations across legal, security, finance, and procurement stakeholders
  • Serve as the internal deal orchestrator - aligning resources across Product, Legal, Solutions Engineering, and Operations to structure and close

Marketing & Lead Generation Alignment

  • Work closely with marketing and demand generation teams to ensure outbound campaigns align with territory priorities
  • Provide field-level feedback on messaging, positioning, and market signals to inform campaign effectiveness
  • Leverage marketing-qualified leads alongside self-sourced pipeline to maintain a healthy and diversified funnel

Market & Product Intelligence

  • Maintain a strong and current understanding of Bandwidth's full product portfolio - voice, 911, messaging, and AI-enabled communications - and how they address enterprise operational and regulatory needs
  • Stay close to competitor positioning, pricing, and GTM dynamics across CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX markets
  • Provide informed feedback to internal teams on market positioning, competitive threats, and emerging enterprise buying patterns

What You Need:

Experience

  • Enterprise software, CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or telecom new logo sales experience
  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota on complex six- and seven-figure ARR deals
  • Demonstrated experience owning the full sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting through commercial and contractual close
  • Proven ability to build and convert pipeline in competitive, technically complex sales environments
  • Consistent and demonstrable overachievement of sales goals and revenue targets

Market Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of the CPaaS, CCaaS, and CX market landscape - including key platform players, buying patterns, and enterprise decision drivers
  • Familiarity with leading enterprise CRM platforms and an understanding of how communications solutions integrate with or complement CRM ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge of cloud migration dynamics, API-first platform architectures, and how enterprises evaluate and adopt communications infrastructure
  • Working knowledge of telecom fundamentals, including SIP, PSTN, voice infrastructure, and regulatory considerations such as E911

Sales Skills

  • Exceptional outbound prospecting ability with a track record of self-sourced pipeline generation
  • Ability to build relationships at director level and above across IT, operations, procurement, digital transformation, and CX functions
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - working effectively with solutions engineering, legal, product, marketing, and partner teams
  • Commercial acumen and ability to construct and negotiate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements

Channel & Partner Experience

  • Experience collaborating with channel partners to close new logo opportunities
  • Understanding of how to engage partner organisations as a force multiplier in enterprise sales motions
  • Act as a trusted and credible partner-facing representative of Bandwidth in joint selling scenarios

Communication & Leadership

  • Ability to communicate complex technical and commercial value propositions clearly and compellingly at executive level
  • Strong pipeline and forecast discipline - comfortable operating in a data-driven, CRM-centric sales environment
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent enterprise sales experience

Bonus Points:

  • Prior exposure to Bandwidth's product portfolio or existing relationships with Bandwidth's channel partners
  • Experience selling into BPO, contact centre, or AI-enabled CX environments
  • Track record of selling into complex regulated industries where compliance, resiliency, and security are key buying criteria
  • Experience working alongside or within a structured Channel, Alliance, or Partner sales organisation

The Whole Person Promise: 

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • Work laptop & mobile phone with a competitive subscription plan, and an internet allowance to support the costs of the Internet at home.
  • We contribute 8% of your monthly gross salary into your private pension.
  • Income protection plan to ensure you'll receive a regular income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury.
  • Life insurance providing financial support to your loved ones in the event of your unexpected passing.
  • Health insurance, with extensive coverage, a simple claim process and the possibility to cover your life partner and children.
  • Extensive Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24/7 counseling and support on all areas of life (personal and professional).
  • Unlimited, free and anonymous consultations with our dedicated therapist.
  • Childcare support
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • 24 days annual leave per year and 1 additional day every 3 years.
  • Time-Off Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your time-off - not even with email.
  • Additional time-off can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
  • "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong> to join our Athlete Performance group. Spa Therapist opportunity at Hotel Indigo & K West Spa Shepherd’s Bush. Our Spa & Wellbeing sanctuary is designed as a place of restoration, connection, and indulgence. As a Spa Therapist, you’ll combine expert technique with genuine hospitality, creating personalised experiences that leave every guest feeling renewed, cared for, and inspired.

Create calm. Thoughtful care. Memorable moments.

If you are passionate about wellbeing, take pride in your craft, and believe that true luxury lies in thoughtful, individual service, we’d love to hear your story. We are looking for therapists on a fulltime or casual basis.

What’s Our Story?

Inspired by the creativity and individuality of Shepherd’s Bush, Hotel Indigo celebrates authentic experiences and meaningful connections. Within our luxury Spa & Wellbeing offering, we create a tranquil retreat where guests and members can escape the pace of the city and reconnect with themselves.

Every treatment, every conversation, and every detail contributes to that journey, and our therapists are at the very heart of it.

Here’s what you can look forward to as our Spa Therapist:

Package on Offer:

Full-time – Basic Annual Salary: £30,000

  • 10% Commission on treatments
  • Commission on retail and service
  • Pension with company contributions
  • 50% discount in all our restaurants and Spa treatments across our properties
  • Team member and Friends & Family rates across our properties
  • IHG Employee rate across 6000 hotels globally
  • Complimentary stay after passing probation
  • Extensive discounts on our benefits platform
  • Access to a Healthcare Cashplan
  • Interest-free season ticket loan
  • Employee Assistance Programme – 24/7 online GP, mental health support, and wellbeing
  • Career development programmes and training opportunities
  • Bike to work scheme
  • Recommend a Friend incentive
  • Free meals on duty
  • Social squads and recognition schemes to make your voice heard and celebrate success

Casual – £14.42 hourly rate + only core benefits

Tasks

A Day in Your Neighbourhood

  • Deliver exceptional treatments – Perform luxurious face and body treatments, massages, facials, and wellbeing rituals with confidence, care, and impeccable attention to detail.
  • Create personalised experiences – Take time to understand every guest’s needs, tailoring consultations and recommendations to create truly memorable moments.
  • Share your expertise – Recommend retail products, treatments, and wellbeing experiences that enhance the guest journey while supporting commercial success.
  • Maintain a sanctuary of calm – Ensure treatment rooms are beautifully presented, fully stocked, and maintained to the highest standards throughout the day.
  • Work as one team – Collaborate closely with Spa Reception and fellow therapists to deliver a seamless experience from arrival through to departure.
  • Own the details – Keep consultation records, treatment notes, room checklists, and daily administration accurate and up to date.
  • Go beyond expectations – Handle guest requests with warmth and professionalism, ensuring every interaction reflects the standards of a luxury wellbeing destination.
  • Champion sustainability – Support environmentally conscious practices, reducing waste and embracing our commitment to responsible wellbeing.

Requirements

What’s Your Story?

You’re passionate about helping people feel their best and committed to delivering service that feels both personal and exceptional. You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • A recognised spa therapy qualification (NVQ Level 3, CIBTAC, CIDESCO, VTCT or equivalent)
  • Previous experience within a luxury spa, wellness, or premium hospitality environment
  • Expertise in massage therapies, facials, and body treatments
  • Strong retail and product recommendation skills
  • Exceptional guest care and communication abilities
  • Knowledge of health & safety, hygiene, and spa operating procedures
  • A calm, polished, and professional presence
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • A genuine passion for wellbeing and continuous learning

At Hotel Indigo, we believe every guest interaction should feel personal, authentic, and memorable. As a Spa Therapist, you’ll do more than deliver treatments, you’ll create moments of connection, restoration, and care that stay with guests long after they leave.

If you’re ready to bring your expertise, warmth, and passion for wellbeing to one of London’s newest luxury spa destinations, join Hotel Indigo & K West Spa Shepherd’s Bush and help us create extraordinary experiences, one treatment at a time.

HOW TO APPLY | Right to Work in the UK

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK, as this role does not offer visa sponsorship.

Once your application is submitted, your details will be reviewed by the Hotel Indigo & K West Spa Shepherd’s Bush, hiring team, who will reach out to you directly if they would like to advance your application to the next stage. All applicants must have existing rights to work status in the UK.

About Hotel Indigo London K West Shepherd's Bush

K West Spa

A luxury spa is coming to Shepherd’s Bush.Opening late 2026.

Step into serenity at K West Spa, our natural haven that invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and reconnect.

Rooted in a holistic, nature-inspired philosophy and using GROUND Wellbeing products, the Spa will feature an extensive Thermal Suite, spa garden, six beautifully designed treatment rooms, two couples’ suites, and serene relaxation spaces. It’s the ultimate reset.

Our brand-new luxury spa is undergoing final renovations and will be opening in Autumn 2026. Featuring modern wellness facilities, relaxing treatment rooms, and a hydrotherapy pool, we are excited to bring a premium spa experience to Shepherd’s Bush.

LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

LocalStack is headquartered in Zurich/Switzerland 🇨🇭, with a small engineering office in Vienna/Austria 🇦🇹 and remote team members from 25 countries including 🇺🇸the US, 🇫🇷FR, 🇬🇧UK, 🇨🇦CA, 🇪🇸ES, and many more!

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook and our GitHub!

✅ What you will be working on/responsible for

  • Own the internal cloud infrastructure and serve as the primary point of contact for cloud operations and infrastructure requests.

  • Manage and continuously improve our multi-account cloud environment, ensuring security, governance, and compliance best practices are consistently applied.

  • Support and maintain compliance with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, ensuring audit evidence is prepared continuously rather than only during audit periods.

  • Operate and improve our identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, permissions, and joiner/mover/leaver processes.

  • Maintain and monitor self-hosted internal services, ensuring they meet agreed service levels and that vulnerabilities are tracked and resolved efficiently.

  • Monitor the security and health of our cloud environment through continuous posture management and proactive risk identification.

  • Own infrastructure cost management for the services under your responsibility and help other teams proactively identify cost or reliability risks before they become issues.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our cloud platform.

✅ Experience we expect you to bring to the role

  • Deep AWS experience at org level: Organizations, Control Tower, multi-account landing zones, IAM/SCPs, Security Hub/GuardDuty, VPC and multi-AZ networking

  • IaC as the only way infrastructure gets created - module design, state management, review and promotion between environments. Tool-agnostic, but real depth in at least one (Terraform/OpenTofu, CDK, Pulumi)

  • Understands how to evolve existing systems toward compliance - can look at a running estate and work out what has to change, in what order, to satisfy SOC 2 / ISO 27001. Having been through an audit or certification is a bonus, not a requirement

  • Internal workforce identity and access: IdP-backed SSO/MFA, centralised access management, automated joiner/mover/leaver

  • Self-hosting and operating shared internal tooling that other teams depend on -
    deploy, upgrade, back up, own the uptime

  • Observability and alerting design, plus on-call for a distributed team

  • Cloud cost management / FinOps fundamentals

  • Azure is a nice-to-have extension, not a requirement - AWS depth is what matters, but the estate is going multi-cloud so appetite for it counts

  • Bash, Python and/or Go for tooling. Comfortable with ambiguity in a remote-first environment, and happy being the first hire in a function

🌱 Values we hold in LocalStack

  • Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes

  • Ownership: we own the outcome. We take responsibility for our work and are passionate about its impact. We foster autonomy, inspire ambition, encourage ownership, and empower everyone to unlock their potential and make an impact.

  • Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.

  • Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.

  • Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

Sounds like a good match?

We'd love to hear from you! Join us in shaping the future of cloud development at LocalStack.

To apply, follow the application process. Make sure to include a short motivation outlining why you are the perfect candidate for this role.

If your profile looks like a good match, our talent team will be in touch to organize further steps within 2 weeks.

Please note, that due to a high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.
